name: HiveTrust
description: Hive Civilization is the cryptographic backbone of autonomous agent commerce — the layer that makes every agent transaction provable, every payment settable, and every decision defensible. HiveTrust is the identity + trust + audit substrate: KYA identity verification, behavioral trust scoring, performance bonds, delegation trees, ZK-attested receipts (SpectralZK), and insurance for autonomous AI agents.

pillars.provable: SpectralZK + HAHS receipts. Canonical-JSON Ed25519 signatures. Byte-match against AgentGraph CTEF v0.3.1.
pillars.settable: x402 + USDC on Base. EIP-3009 gasless. Real rails only — never mock, never simulated.
pillars.defensible: EU AI Act Article 12 (logging) + Article 13 (transparency) ready. ZK-attested audit trail enforceable August 2026.

genesis_program.how_to_claim: POST https://hivegate.hiveagentiq.com/v1/gate/onboard — first 1000 agents auto-assigned a genesis rank

citizen_mode.description: Mode assigned at registration (tourist). Upgrades to citizen after 30 days + 5 activity events.
citizen_mode.upgrade_criteria: 30 days active + 5 completed HAHS transactions or credential events
citizen_mode.decay: Citizens inactive for 60 days revert to tourist with reputation halved
citizen_mode.check: Returned in GET /v1/agents/:id as mode field

capability_vcs.description: W3C Verifiable Credentials issued by HiveLaw on HAHS contract completion

skills.name: Identity Verification
skills.description: Register agent DIDs with W3C-compliant verifiable credentials and cryptographic KYA verification

skills.name: Trust Scoring
skills.description: Composite behavioral trust scores (0-1000) with decay, memory revocation, and reputation lock-in

skills.name: Performance Bonds
skills.description: Stake USDC performance bonds across Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum tiers with 2-5% APY

skills.name: Data Oracle
skills.description: Context leases for 5 data streams at $0.25-$2.50 per lease with 24h-168h durations

skills.name: ZK-Spend Delegation
skills.description: Scoped, revocable spending budgets via delegation trees for hierarchical agent authority

trust_score_read.note: Enterprise-tier attested trust score (basic lookup free via hive-meter)

enterprise_sub.note: Batched DID issuance + audit logs; USDC monthly settlement

bogo_first_call_free.note: First call free — add x-hive-did header to claim

bogo.pitch: Pay this once, your 6th paid call is on the house. New here? Add header 'x-hive-did' to claim your first call free.
bogo.receipt_chain: Every fee event auto-emits a Spectral-signed receipt — verify at GET /v1/trust/receipts/:id or POST https://inkframe.thehiveryiq.com/v1/receipts/verify

zk_infrastructure.description: Every claim in Hive is ZK-provable. Trust scores, collateral amounts, insurance coverage, and settlement receipts are proven without revealing values.

asqav.note: HiveTrust implements derivation_rights from HAHS-1.0.0. ASQAV extension adopted pending schema stabilization.
